voiceName: Dorien (phone, garden, no denoise), the clone used for Rooted. Never de-ess it.

lines.n_intro_fallback: I build websites for small businesses in Panama. Almost none of them can afford an SEO agency.
lines.n_hook: Fifty-seven percent of small businesses have no SEO strategy at all. No wonder. An agency retainer runs about three thousand dollars a month.
lines.n_hook2: And page two of Google? A fifth of one percent of clicks.
lines.n_wa1: Text her any link on WhatsApp. She reads the page, checks what Google sees, and answers in plain words, ranked by impact.
lines.n_voice: Then she says it out loud.
lines.n_speed: Google's own data: fifty-three percent of mobile visits are abandoned when a page takes more than three seconds to load. Lucienne found five point nine, and explained exactly why it matters.
lines.n_web: She lives on the web too. While she inspects, her lantern glows. And when the results land, she smiles.
lines.n_email: Ask for the full report, and a developer briefing lands in your inbox. Every finding with impact, evidence, and the exact fix.
lines.n_hub: One copilot, every channel. The same agent and the same tools answer on WhatsApp, web chat and email, with SMS wired and waiting on carrier registration.
lines.n_arch: Under the hood, it is all AWS. Messages come in through End User Messaging, into SNS and Lambda. Amazon Bedrock runs the agent loop, DynamoDB remembers the conversation, Polly gives her the voice, and SES delivers the report.
lines.n_biz_fallback: Lucienne already audits Papito's Nature Tours, my partner's boat tour company in Bocas del Toro. She's registered as an ACE opportunity, and next come the tour operators and small businesses I already build websites for.
lines.n_close: Lucienne. Drop her a link. She'll bring some clarity.
lines.n_numbers: Measured on the live agent: about three cents per reply, voice note included. And it runs in the business's own AWS account.
